ideas.title: Brush size preview
ideas.line: See the brush circle at its real size and falloff before you stroke.
ideas.where: Brush settings and the canvas cursor

ideas.title: Brush Accumulate on/off
ideas.line: Turn it off so a stroke does not pile up over itself.

ideas.title: Brush auto-masking
ideas.line: Directional, cavity, backface and other auto-masks set per brush.

ideas.title: Kitbash insert library
ideas.line: A library of ready-made pieces you stamp onto the surface.

ideas.title: Move brush reach beyond the edge
ideas.line: A small buffer distance, so the Move brush still grabs the surface when the cursor is just outside the silhouette, instead of you having to rotate the camera.

ideas.title: Smooth-peaks brush
ideas.line: Smooths only the high points and leaves the valleys alone.

ideas.title: Wood detail brush pack
ideas.line: Weathered grain and splinter brushes from scanned planks, with random stamps.

ideas.title: Noise panel
ideas.line: A pop-up to add procedural or alpha noise to the whole model with curves, live preview, mask by noise and presets, then apply.
ideas.where: a small sidebar panel whose Make Noise button opens the pop-up

ideas.title: Split cut mode
ideas.line: Cut new face groups along a line or shape without removing anything.

ideas.title: Stored masks
ideas.line: Store, load, merge, rename and reorder masks.

ideas.title: Polygon modelling mode
ideas.line: Beginner-friendly Points, Edges and Polygons panels: extrude, smart bevel, bridge, circle from edges, for hard-surface work next to sculpting.
ideas.where: a new Model mode with its own panels

ideas.title: Edit base mesh, keep detail
ideas.line: Step down to the low-resolution cage, move, extrude or add loops, then step back up with all your detail re-applied.
ideas.where: the Subdivide levels in the Topology panel

ideas.title: Retopology (draw quads over a sculpt)
ideas.line: Draw quads, strips and loops on the surface to get a clean low-poly mesh that keeps the detail.

ideas.title: Make Symmetric: choose the side to keep
ideas.line: Pick which half is kept and mirrored (now it keeps the +X side), so you can work on either side.

ideas.title: Panel tool
ideas.line: Turn a selection or face group into a thin panel with thickness and edge loops.

ideas.title: Quad Remesh options (incl. fusing pieces)
ideas.line: Adaptive density, Repeat, Retry and curve strength for guides, plus fusing overlapping pieces into one clean mesh in a single step.

ideas.title: Mesh Bridge
ideas.line: Bridge between regions with standard, smooth and slime types and tensions.

ideas.title: Tessellation panel
ideas.line: Pre-subdivision, thickness and shape input with preview.

ideas.title: Blend across Parts
ideas.line: Let smoothing and dynamic topology blend an added Part into the surface.

ideas.title: Micro levels: rebuild and merge
ideas.line: Rebuild subdivision levels from a micro level, or turn the top levels into one.

ideas.title: Sculpt layers on micro levels
ideas.line: Keep sculpt layers working on micro levels.

ideas.title: Voxel Remesh minimum thickness
ideas.line: Keep thin tips from vanishing when you Voxel Remesh.

ideas.title: Divide levels to Blender as Multires
ideas.line: Send your subdivision levels to Blender as Multires.

ideas.title: Confirm before destructive remesh
ideas.line: A pop-up before Voxel Remesh, Quad Remesh or Decimate drops subdivision levels.

ideas.title: Voxel Remesh above 512
ideas.line: Go up to 4096 with a polygon estimate and a one-time warning.

ideas.title: Mesh array
ideas.line: Repeat and chain copies of a Part without merging: offset, scale, rotate and pivot per stage, mirror and align options, an on/off pattern, a live preview, then bake it to a mesh.

ideas.title: Primitive blockout kit
ideas.line: Cylinder, capsule, cone and torus, click to place, then merge.

ideas.title: New Parts land on the origin
ideas.line: New Parts and tools land exactly on the world origin so symmetry works.

ideas.title: Morph panel
ideas.line: Store, Delete, Apply and Accumulate morphs, separate from Sculpt layers.

ideas.title: Pose with a simple rig
ideas.line: Pose a Part with a quick skeleton, then bake the pose into the mesh.

ideas.title: Node-based sculpting
ideas.line: Build a model as a chain of nodes (mesh, remesh, mask, sculpt, mirror, merge, export) instead of destructive edits, so any step can be changed later.

ideas.title: Gizmo free-move handles
ideas.line: Four small handles on the Gizmo (All) to drag a Part in any direction on screen, not only along an axis, without losing symmetry.

ideas.title: Smooth blend for Booleans (SDF style)
ideas.line: A blend radius on Boolean Parts, so a union or subtract can merge softly like a simple SDF modeller, with control over how far the merge reaches.

ideas.title: Save a project with only some Parts
ideas.line: Slim a file down by saving only the visible Parts.

ideas.title: Mesh Boolean preview
ideas.line: Live Union, Subtract and Intersect preview, then Make Boolean Mesh.

ideas.title: Draw and move in one mode
ideas.line: Drag a sphere to move it and draw new ones without switching.

ideas.title: Tube that subtracts
ideas.line: Carve a tube stroke into the surface like a boolean subtract.

ideas.title: Tube profiles
ideas.line: Square, disc and other cross-sections for the Tube tool.

ideas.title: Cloth panel
ideas.line: One place for the Cloth brush settings and for running a simulation.

ideas.title: Wind for Drape
ideas.line: Direction and turbulence so cloth can blow in the wind, still or live.

ideas.title: More lights and soft shadows
ideas.line: More lights, ambient occlusion and soft shadows in the render.

ideas.title: Lit Sphere material per Part
ideas.line: Give each Part its own Lit Sphere material.

ideas.title: Paint layers
ideas.line: Stack paint in layers with blend modes and opacity, like sculpt layers, and export each layer as its own colour attribute.

ideas.title: Clickable orientation widget
ideas.line: Click a 3D widget at the top right to jump to front, side or top.

ideas.title: Split view
ideas.line: A second live view, for example side view while you sculpt the front.

ideas.title: Frozen multi-angle view
ideas.line: Stamp the current view onto the canvas as a flat picture to turn the model against.

ideas.title: View Figure choices
ideas.line: A built-in skull plus your own model as the corner figure.

ideas.title: Turntable video export
ideas.line: Render a turntable of your sculpt to a video file in one click.

ideas.title: Silhouette view
ideas.line: A small window with a flat black outline of the model, with saved camera angles and lens in mm, to judge the shape.

ideas.title: Mouse orbit speed and smoothing
ideas.line: A setting for how fast the mouse turns the view, with optional smoothing, so rotating with the middle button (for example in Blender style) feels slower and calmer.

ideas.title: Reference image board
ideas.line: Pin reference images next to the canvas and pick colours from them.

ideas.title: Rooms
ideas.line: Separate workspaces for Sculpt, Model, Paint and UV, each with its own tools, panels and keys, and a clean hand-off of the model; also the backbone of the coming tablet and phone app.
ideas.where: a workspace switcher at the top of the window

ideas.title: Tab hides one shelf
ideas.line: Tab over a shelf hides only that shelf.

ideas.title: One-click Update on macOS
ideas.line: Update from the banner in one click, as on Linux and Windows.

ideas.title: Screencast overlay
ideas.line: Show pressed keys and mouse buttons for talks and tutorials.

ideas.title: Touch navigation on desktop
ideas.line: Pen sculpts, fingers orbit, pan and zoom, with an option to lock touch.

ideas.title: Custom interface colours
ideas.line: Pick your own accent and panel colours.

ideas.title: Tablet and mobile app (iPad, Android)
ideas.line: SculptForge on iPad and Android tablets, with pen pressure and a touch-first layout.

ideas.title: VR sculpting
ideas.line: Sculpt in VR (later and large).

ideas.title: Simpler app icon
ideas.line: A simpler icon that reads well when small.

ideas.title: Alternate interface
ideas.line: A modern, cleaner alternative to the current layout, with fewer buttons, sliders and tabs on screen at once.

ideas.title: Taller Parts panel
ideas.line: The Parts list has little room: a drag handle to make it taller, or a scrollbar, so long lists fit.

ideas.title: Hotkeys in categories
ideas.line: Group the long alphabetical shortcut list into categories such as Sculpt (the brushes), Navigation and Modifier keys, starting with the sculpt shortcuts. Navigation would hold the pan and zoom keys; Modifiers the mask, smooth, gizmo and symmetry X, Y, Z commands.

ideas.title: Custom quick panel
ideas.line: Drag any buttons and sections from any palette into your own panel; float it on a key or dock it.
ideas.where: Customize Shelves, then a new panel you build

ideas.title: Multi-key shortcut sequences
ideas.line: Bind sequences like A then A for more keys.

ideas.title: Startup splash screen
ideas.line: A splash with the first-run welcome card.

ideas.title: Separate Pan keys
ideas.line: Bind pan left, right, up and down separately for game pads.

ideas.title: Shortcut conflict warning
ideas.line: Warn when a key is already used, plus a per-shortcut reset.

ideas.title: Discord Rich Presence
ideas.line: Opt-in status in Discord while you sculpt, off by default.

ideas.title: Render bridge
ideas.line: Send a quick render, or the scene with its materials and vertex paint, to an external renderer or image editor in one click.

ideas.title: Houdini link via USD
ideas.line: Watch a USD file and reload it when it changes.

ideas.title: Blender Bridge round trip
ideas.line: Update the base mesh and keep detail layers; shape keys come back as layers.

ideas.title: SpaceMouse on macOS
ideas.line: Use a SpaceMouse next to the 3Dconnexion driver on macOS.

ideas.title: One export panel
ideas.line: A format drop-down plus an OBJ and displacement preset.

ideas.title: UV unwrap with seams
ideas.line: Mark seams, unwrap and pack UVs without leaving SculptForge.

ideas.title: 3D print prep
ideas.line: Hollow, add escape holes and split with keys, ready for printing.

ideas.title: Local-only AI
ideas.line: Run Brush Lab and image-to-3D fully on your machine, nothing sent to the cloud.
